### 🟡 Changes recommended The new default-off test asserts Rust struct layout/size for `Overlay`, which is not guaranteed and can cause brittle CI failures unrelated to behavior. *Once you've addressed the issues Copilot identified, you can request another Copilot review.*
Pull request overview This PR adds an **opt-in** `sparq-core/overlay-deleted-projections` feature that caches perm-sorted projections of the deletion overlay and uses binary range counting for subsequent scans/estimates, keeping the default build behavior unchanged. **Changes:** - Add feature-gated cached tombstone projections (`deleted_by_perm`) and use them for `Overlay::count_correction`. - Add a dedicated core test module covering cache laziness, invalidation, concurrency, and fork/snapshot behavior (feature on/off). - Document the opt-in (core README + SPARQL query skill), add a feature-matrix `test: true` leg, and add a standalone `bench/overlay-count` diagnostic harness + benchmark registry entry.
File summaries | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | skills/sparql-query/SKILL.md | Documents how to opt into the experimental deletion projection cache and its tradeoffs. | | scripts/tests/feature-matrix-legnames.golden.txt | Registers the new feature-matrix leg name in the golden list. | | crates/sparq-core/src/store/overlay_deleted_tests.rs | New tests for deletion projection caching behavior across feature on/off modes. | | crates/sparq-core/src/store.rs | Implements feature-gated `deleted_by_perm` caching, invalidation, and range counting. | | crates/sparq-core/README.md | Documents the experimental feature and its operational tradeoffs. | | crates/sparq-core/Cargo.toml | Defines the new default-off `overlay-deleted-projections` feature flag. | | .github/feature-matrix.d/sparq-core.yml | Adds a dedicated `test: true` CI leg for the new opt-in feature. | | bench/overlay-count/src/main.rs | Standalone diagnostic runner producing JSON-line measurements for cold/warm read paths. | | bench/overlay-count/src/lifecycle.rs | Lifecycle-focused diagnostic scenarios (fork/snapshot/generation retention/concurrency). | | bench/overlay-count/src/counting.rs | Optional bench-only counting allocator wrapper for requested bytes/alloc metrics. | | bench/overlay-count/README.md | Documents the diagnostic protocol and how to run comparable measurements. | | bench/overlay-count/Cargo.toml | Defines the detached diagnostic crate and dependencies. | | bench/overlay-count/Cargo.lock | Locks diagnostic crate dependencies for reproducible offline runs. | | bench/benchmarks.toml | Registers the new diagnostic in the benchmark catalog (non-featured, diagnostic status). | | bench/feature-off-declarations/6469.json | Records the feature-off wasm bundle neutrality evidence for this PR. |

This test asserts `size_of::<Overlay>()` and `align_of::<Overlay>()` based on an assumed field layout/no-padding guarantee, but `Overlay` is not `repr(C)` and Rust does not guarantee field order or padding across compiler versions/targets. This makes the default-off test brittle and can fail without any behavioral regression.
